run_right_hand_demo: run the right hand only demo script on images in the ./images directory
run_inference_get_mano_params: run inference to extract right hand MANO pose, shape, and root translation parameters
render_right_hand_mesh: render the predicted right hand 3D mesh overlay onto the original input image
save_right_hand_mesh_obj: save the predicted right hand mesh as an OBJ file with MANO face topology
visualize_right_hand_skeleton: visualize the right hand 2D skeleton keypoints with skeleton connections on the image
